metadata.description: ParrotIt for Claude. For people filling forms: use your encrypted vault, decrypted only on your own machine. For businesses sending forms: ask about your forms, analytics, kiosks and Keys. Never what people wrote.

plugins.name: parrotit
plugins.description: Your desktop AI reads and saves details from your encrypted ParrotIt vault on demand — decrypted only on your device, every read and save logged, revocable any time. Sensitive data and saving are off by default.

plugins.name: parrotit-setter
plugins.description: For businesses that send ParrotIt forms. Ask Claude about your forms, analytics, kiosks and Keys. It sees questions and counts, never what people wrote, and it can't publish, send or delete.
